query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.role, d.id as dealer_id, d.name as dealer_name, d.subscriptionStatus, d.subscriptionExpiresAt
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN dealers d ON u.id = d.userId
WHERE u.role = 'dealer'
LIMIT 5;
